description: A pile of small multicolored beads sits on a red bedspread near a white pillow, with a few purple beads off to the side. The left hand reaches in from the right, taps and scoops at the main pile, then drags and nudges several purple beads away to form a small grouped cluster, returning to the main pile to separate and push more beads into place; the beads are a left-hand object whenever the fingers are touching them, otherwise they rest on the bed.
